A Story About Becoming Who You Were Meant To Be

Chase Your Dreams follows the journey of someone who discovers that dreams rarely arrive at the perfect moment. They appear when life is uncertain, confidence is low, and the road ahead is unclear.


Every chapter explores a different part of the journey: the fear of starting, the pain of failure, the discipline to continue, and the courage to believe in yourself again.


This is not a story about becoming perfect. It is a story about refusing to give up.

Meet Bilawal Kehar

Author, Storyteller, Dreamer

Bilawal Kehar writes for people who are standing at the beginning of something uncertain: a dream, a new chapter, or a future they have not yet imagined.


Through his writing, Bilawal explores ambition, resilience, self-belief, and the human courage required to keep moving when success feels far away.
